item.noTitle: No title in this language: this item is left out of lists and has no heading.

image.noTitle: This image has no title in the media library, so it has no alternative text.

richText.imageWithoutAlt: An image in this text has no alternative text: it is ignored by screen readers.
richText.tableWithoutCaption: A table in this text has no caption: give it one so that it can be found and understood.

cta.noTarget: No link target in this language
cta.noLink: This button has a label but no link: choose a page or a web address, or clear the label.

list.startMissing: The start folder is set but cannot be found here (deleted, or not published yet): the list shows nothing on the live site.

story.membersNotice: The rest of this story is for members. Create an account or sign in to read on.
story.membersEdit: Members only: visitors who are not signed in see the summary, the opening paragraphs and a notice to register or sign in.
story.captionsMissing: Add the episode's captions (a WebVTT file) to show the audio player.
story.membersNoticeSignIn: The rest of this story is for members. Sign in to read on.

feed.summary: Lists the stories ({{formats}}) under {{start}}, newest first, up to {{max}}.
feed.pageCategories: Only the stories filed under this page's categories or their subcategories.
feed.pageNoCategory: This page has no category: give it its topic as a category, or the feed shows nothing.
feed.noMatch: No story of this format here.

session.membersNotice: The rest of this session's description is for members. Create an account or sign in to read on.
session.membersEdit: Members only: visitors who are not signed in see the session's details and the opening paragraphs of its description, then a notice to register or sign in.
session.membersNoticeSignIn: The rest of this session's description is for members. Sign in to read on.

agenda.summary: Lists the sessions under {{start}}, by day in the {{zone}} time zone.

gallery.summary: Lists the people under {{start}} by name, up to {{max}}.

brief.closedNotice: This brief is closed: it no longer accepts submissions.
brief.noDescription: Add the brief's description: it is where suppliers read what is expected of them.
brief.noForm: Choose the submission form: without it suppliers cannot answer this brief.
brief.formUnavailable: The submission form is not available: it is not a Formidable form, or it cannot be read (deleted, not published yet, or restricted). Visitors see no form.

briefList.summary: Lists the briefs under {{start}} that each visitor may read, {{scope}}, nearest deadline first, up to {{max}}.

submissionList.summary: Lists the submissions under {{start}} that each visitor may read, newest first, up to {{max}}.

search.label: Search the site
search.none: Nothing matches these words. Try other words, or fewer.
search.unavailable: Search is not available at the moment. Please try again later.
search.hint: Type words or choose filters to see results.
